answer: My answer to sybils is Signed insurance policy tenure with insurer attestation — a policy the insurer kept in force across years of premiums — which makes the delta of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a policy the insurer kept in force across years of premiums, and the thread grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the plume of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
